result.summary: The PR changes inBounds from `index < length` to `index <= length`, which breaks the documented contract. For nonnegative integer length the valid indices are 0 through length-1, and empty collections have no valid index; the new comparison wrongly treats index == length as in bounds. Frozen CI counterexamples inBounds(3,3) and inBounds(0,0) now return true instead of false.
